title: Babysitting AI Agents: A User-Centered Taxonomy and Study of Agentic Delegation Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.34748v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Users are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, allowing agents to perform long-running, multi-step workflows on their behalf. However, agents may perform these tasks in ways that depart from users' expectations for how they should be carried out, leading to what we call agentic delegation failures. We leverage a large corpus of 163,487 Reddit posts, describing AI agent use, to develop MANDATE: a taxonomy of 23 failure categories organized into seven groups. A follow-up study with 73 AI agent users examined the relationship between prevalence and perceptions of severity and noticeability, finding that failures rated as more severe are considered harder to notice, and that prior experience with a failure is associated with greater noticeability. Finally, we assess the maturity of research on each failure and identify commonly encountered failures that have received little attention (e.g., agents running without making progress). O

translated_title: 照看AI智能体：以用户为中心的智能体委托失败分类法与研究
translated_abstract: 用户越来越多地将任务委托给AI智能体，让智能体代表自己执行长时间运行的多步骤工作流程。然而，智能体执行这些任务的方式可能偏离用户对其执行方式的期望，从而产生我们所说的“智能体委托失败”。我们利用包含163,487条Reddit帖子的海量语料库（描述AI智能体的使用情况），开发出MANDATE：一个由23个失败类别组成、划分为七大组的分类体系。随后一项针对73名AI智能体用户的研究考察了失败普遍性与严重程度感知和可察觉性之间的关系，发现被评为更严重的失败被认为更难察觉，而且对某种失败的既往经验与其更高的可察觉性相关。最后，我们评估了针对每种失败的研究成熟度，并识别出常见却鲜受关注的失败类型（例如，智能体运行却毫无进展）。
tldr: 该研究基于163,487条Reddit帖子构建了包含23个失败类别的MANDATE分类法，系统刻画了用户委托AI智能体时的失败类型，发现越严重的失败越难被察觉，并指出了常见却缺乏研究关注的失败场景。
en_tdlr: This study develops MANDATE, a user-centered taxonomy of 23 agentic delegation failure categories derived from 163,487 Reddit posts, finding that more severe failures are harder to notice and identifying common failures that have received little research attention.
